# Oxikube key bindings

This file is generated from the keymaps embedded in the app
(`crates/platform/oxikube_assets/assets/keymaps/`) and the command titles. CI fails when
it is stale: run `cargo xtask gen-keymap-docs` after changing a keymap or a command title.

Layers, weakest first: the default keymap of your OS, the base keymap chosen with the
`base_keymap` setting (`default`, `k9s` or `vim`), then your own `keymap.json`, which wins.
Switching `base_keymap` takes effect at once and never rewrites `keymap.json`. Within a
layer a later binding beats an earlier one, and `null` unbinds a key of a weaker layer.

## Default keymap, macOS

`default-macos.json`. Always loaded on macOS. `cmd` is the primary modifier.
